notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(9)' (ten cards listed): Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself, Death Star: Detention Block Corridor, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Yavin 4: Docking Bay, Yavin 4: Massassi War Room, Prisoner 2187, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection, Staging Areas, Strike Planning; these count toward the deck. Several Effects start, none named as the starting Effect, so none is marked.

The list as published totals 60 (the Characters header says 18 but 17 are listed). The author's update says there was one card too many and it should be only one Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; the list is kept as posted (two Han).

Posted 'Death Star Detention Block Corridor' dested the Light Special Edition Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (the Premiere one is Dark); 'Death Star Docking Bay 327', 'Yavin 4 Docking Bay', 'Tatooine Docking Bay 94' dested the Light Premiere sites; 'Home One Docking Bay' dested Home One: Docking Bay.
Insurrection and Staging Areas are posted as separate cards and kept separate.
